title: Future analyst China equipment market dataset
license_notes: Confirm permitted storage and derived-output use when acquired; no values in this pilot.

title: Third-party reference market and price data
notes: SEGREGATED REFERENCE TIER. Third-party market sizing and price estimates recorded for context and orientation only. These are NOT verified figures and NOT approved denominators: population, geography, product boundary and vintage are the publisher's and have not been reconciled to atlas scopes. The reconciliation engine refuses these as inputs unless a recipe explicitly sets reference_input_approved and states why the boundaries match. Do not derive a market share, localisation rate or any published figure from this dataset.

title: China Customs online statistics: semiconductor equipment trade (statistics/china_customs)
license_notes: Official PRC statistics from stats.customs.gov.cn; raw exports and as-reported tables committed. Geography: mainland China customs territory (all fabs located in mainland China, including foreign-owned). Data layer only; no derived values.

title: UN Comtrade China-reported HS6 SME trade (statistics/comtrade)
license_notes: UN Comtrade public preview API; as-reported annual values committed. Data layer only; no derived values.

title: Eurostat Comext EU exports to China/Hong Kong and annual euro exchange rates (statistics/eurostat)
license_notes: Eurostat open data (reuse permitted with attribution); as-published values committed. Data layer only; no derived values.

title: CEPEA semiconductor equipment industry statistics from 行业简讯 bulletins (statistics/cepea)
license_notes: Bulletins marked 行业内交流; transcribed figures and a hash index committed, PDFs held locally and not redistributed. Survey of domestic makers (semiconductor equipment revenue >= CNY 10m); 'semiconductor equipment' includes solar-cell equipment. Data layer only; no derived values.
